title: Studio Interfaces: a dashboard draft the server refuses to read (403) still opens an editable empty buffer under the refusal strip, and a Source edit autosaves over the draft unpinned, dropping its requiredPermissions
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZtZMhQkARKJtViA9U

Filing gate: ① a product defect, the #29015 path re-checked live after its fix (#29132, #29275, #29380), reach: the Studio autosave PUT, measured on two independent boots by two runners (10 of 11 and 7 of 9 fresh loads).
Business reason: an author opening a dashboard whose draft carries an audience gate (`requiredPermissions`) they do not hold now sees #29132's refusal strip, but on most loads Studio also renders an editable form under it. An edit through the header's Source tool autosaves over the draft with no If-Match: the gate and every draft-only change are lost, and publishing then serves the dashboard to everyone. That is exactly the data loss #29015 was filed (and fixed) for, so the 18.3.0 release blocker's fix is incomplete. It is not an authorization hole: the author holds metadata write on their own package.
Reader who acts: the triage seat, then a `domain:ui` implementer in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (the Interfaces leaf load) and the #29132 test. QA suggestion only: `area:studio`; it re-opens the #29015 release-blocker path, so the director seat decides whether it blocks 18.3.0.
Duplicate search (incl. closed): `"refuses to read" draft Studio` → 27 hits, `StudioDesignSurface draft 403` → 29, `requiredPermissions draft 403 Studio dashboard` → 38. Nearest: #29015 (closed by #29132, the original), #29148 (closed by #29275/#29380, the four other editors and the pillar load; the list-view editor re-measured here holds). None covers the Interfaces-leaf ordering.

## Reproduction (subject `589049b0`, main)
1. Writable package PKG (`POST /api/v1/packages`), a published dashboard D with one metric widget, and an app whose navigation entry names D.
2. As admin (no set grants `showcase.export_data`): `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/D?mode=draft&package=PKG` with the published body plus `"requiredPermissions":["showcase.export_data"]` → 200 draft.
3. `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard/D?state=draft&package=PKG`: admin → 403 PERMISSION_DENIED; an entitled reader (admin role + `admin_full_access` + `showcase_ops`) → 200 with `requiredPermissions`.
4. Fresh browser, form sign-in as admin, open `/_console/studio/PKG/interfaces` (D auto-selected) or the deep link `/_console/studio/PKG/metadata/dashboard/D`.
5. Observed: the refusal strip ("This item has an unpublished draft you are not allowed to read…") AND, under it, the Properties inspector (Label empty, Widgets 0) and the item tools; Source reads `{}`. 10 of 11 loads (runner 2: 7 of 9); the deep link 4 of 4. No input was sent before observing (≥6 s after the 403).
6. Inspector Label edit → `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/D?mode=draft&package=PKG&surface=studio` `{"label":"…"}`, no If-Match → 422 INVALID_METADATA (name, widgets). The draft survives only because the inspector cannot supply `name` (`metadata-admin/dashboard-schema.ts` hides it).
7. Source tool (`[data-testid=studio-item-tool-source]`): replace `{}` with the published body (name, label, columns, widgets), close the sheet → same PUT, no If-Match → **200**. The entitled reader's draft read now has no `requiredPermissions` and its draft-only label is gone; admin's draft read flips 403 → 200. 2 of 2 per runner (Interfaces and deep link).

Expected (the #29132 contract): Studio opens no buffer over a draft the server refuses to read; no autosave can be sent from that leaf. Actual: an empty editable buffer with a live, unpinned autosave on most loads.

## Mechanism (read from source at the subject, consistent with both runs)
- The designers register through a dynamic import (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` ~L425), so `isEditable = !!Preview && !StudioCanvas` (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` ~L5131) can be false on the first render.
- In that state the `!current || !isEditable` arm (~L5240–5251) installs `draft = {}` with `setDraftFor(leafKey)` and no version pin.
- When the preview registers, the effect re-runs; its refused (403) branch (~L5284–5290) only calls `setError` and returns, leaving `draftFor === leafKey`, so `useDraftAutoSave` (`useDraftAutoSave.ts` ~L167, `loadedFor === target`) reports loaded: item tools (~L6473) and inspector show and the autosave is live. The object, flow and app 403 branches clear theirs (`setObjDraftFor('')` ~L8116, `setDraftFor('')` ~L10565, `setAppDraftFor('')` ~L4983).
- `StudioDesignSurface.draftUnreadable-29015.test.tsx` registers the dashboard preview in `beforeEach` (~L152), so it never reaches this ordering.
